ModMetaData.name: Better Hunters (Combat Extended)
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description:
Makes Combat Extended hunters position before they shoot.
Stock CE hunters open fire the instant an animal enters weapon range. Weapon ranges are long, CE's hit chance falls off hard with distance, and the usual result is a string of low-probability shots that wound the animal - which then flees, or turns on the hunter.
Better Hunters walks the hunter in until Combat Extended's own hit-chance solver says the first shot is a high-probability kill, then fires. Not one cell closer than it needs to be.
It will not close past a safety standoff worked out from how likely and how bad retaliation would be: the animal's revenge chance, its body size, whether it is a predator, and how many of its herd are standing nearby. If no easy shot exists outside that standoff, the hunter holds and takes the worse shot rather than starting a fight - unless the round should drop the animal outright.
If the hunting weapon carries a CE bipod, the hunter deploys it at the firing position before shooting, then carries on with the hunt. Stock CE never does this for a hunter: its bipod auto-setup only runs for drafted pawns, and a colonist on hunting duty never is.
Everything is configurable in mod settings - easy-shot hit chance, tolerated revenge chance, herd sensitivity, maximum standoff, and a master on/off switch.
REQUIRES COMBAT EXTENDED. This mod does nothing without it.
Behaviour only. No new defs, no saved data - safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
Affects the colonist hunting job only. Predator hunting, drafted combat and CE melee hunting are left exactly as they were.
Version: 1.0.0
Changelog: 1.0.0 - Initial release - Smart hunter positioning: walks in only until CE's own hit-chance solver says the first shot is an easy kill, and no closer than a safety standoff scaled to how likely and how bad retaliation is. - Re-checks the standoff during the whole approach, not just at the start: re-routes to a fresh safe cell if the prey drifts toward the firing spot, and breaks off the hunt - with an optional pause and alert so you can take over - if the prey closes the distance onto the hunter. - Deploys a CE bipod at the firing position before shooting, which stock CE never does for hunters.
